items.title: Special right of termination due to price increase
items.quote: Ihre Kündigung muss uns vor diesem Tag erreichen.
items.computation: The letter grants a special termination right under § 41 Abs. 5 EnWG tied to the price change taking effect on 01.05.2025. It states the cancellation must reach the provider 'vor diesem Tag' (before 01.05.2025), so the last day it can arrive is the calendar day before, 30.04.2025 (a Wednesday, no weekend/holiday shift applies since this is a 'before' date, not a period end).

warnings: The letter itself sets an explicit price increase and cancellation deadline; there is no sign of phishing, but as with any price-change letter it is worth comparing the IBAN and sender details against earlier bills before relying solely on this letter for payments (the IBAN DE76 3705 0198 0002 0020 00 is formally valid but that does not confirm who owns the account).
